description.value: This study examined associations between SOD2 genotype and normalized gray matter volume in chronic alcohol users, and evaluated additional candidate-gene associations using quantitative MRI and genotype data.
Observational, cross-sectional study of alcohol users and light-drinking controls, with MRI and genotype data collected at one study visit.

name.value: SOD2 diplotype association with GMR in low drinking group

definition.value: SOD2 diplotype association with normalized gray matter volume in the low drinking group

spans.text: In this large-scale hypothesis-driven genetic analysis of chronic alcohol-associated brain volume loss, we replicated a previous association between GM shrinkage and   SOD2   genotype in individuals with relatively low LAC levels ( Srivastava et al., 2010 ).

value: SOD2 diplotype was significantly associated with GMR in the low drinking group (P = .009); the Ala16/Ala16-homozygous diplotype was associated with the lowest GMR. This association was not observed in the higher-than-median drinking group, suggesting that SOD2-related genetic protection is present only at relatively low alcohol exposure.

definition.value: Associations between gene-specific SNPs and gray matter ratio across the entire sample

spans.text: In this large-scale hypothesis-driven genetic analysis of chronic alcohol-associated brain volume loss, we replicated a previous association between GM shrinkage and   SOD2   genotype in individuals with relatively low LAC levels ( Srivastava et al., 2010 ).

value: Eight genes or gene loci showed nominally significant associations with GMR in the full sample, including ADH1A-B-C, AKT1, CYP2B6, GCLC, NFE2L2, NOS3, SLC1A2, and SYT1. None of these associations survived correction for multiple testing.

spans.text: We applied a T1-weighted magnetization prepared rapid acquisition gradient echo sequence (TR/TI/TE = 9/300/4ms, 1 x 1mm  in-plane resolution, 1.5-mm slabs) oriented orthogonal to the long axis of the hippocampus and an oblique-axial T2-weighted spin-echo sequence (TR/TE = 2500/80ms, 1 x 1mm  in-plane resolution, 3-mm slice thickness) oriented along an imaginary line connecting the anterior and posterior commissures as seen on a mid-sagittal scout image.
